profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading as GEHC. Its website describes the company as providing digital infrastructure, data analytics, and decision support tools for diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring of patients. The company says it has over 130 years of delivering solutions and aims to create a world where healthcare has no limits.

On AI, the company states it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It describes its work as building integrated solutions to help hospitals and healthcare systems operate and to make therapies more accurate and effective.

SEC records list the company under CIK 0001932393. Illinois court records show 375 entries involving the company.
